body.objective: Construct and audit the first finite positive Euclidean lattice pilot for the Bateman--Turok perfect-square scalar, including the auxiliary-field normalization, exact finite-lattice invariants and a bounded deterministic sampler calibration.
activates: a nonperturbative Euclidean computational experiment with an exact finite-spacing definition
a step-scaling continuum-limit study after independent sampler and finite-size validation
a precise separation between positive Euclidean weight and Lorentzian probability
body.current_gate: Derive the Omega/Upsilon Gaussian-elimination coefficient from the published O(1,1) action, choose a shift-exact positive finite lattice on Omega>0 with the D Omega/Omega measure, prove its vacuum and free-spectrum properties, and calibrate a deterministic zero-mode-fixed HMC pilot against exact free and Schwinger--Dyson checks.
body.stop_condition: Certify either a finite positive lattice action with a bounded numerical pilot and explicit continuum/Lorentzian nonclaims, or the first exact normalization, measure, zero-mode, stability or sampling obstruction. Do not infer a continuum QFT or a Lorentzian scattering theorem from finite Euclidean data.
body.forbid: no claim of Osterwalder--Schrader positivity; no continuum-limit claim; no analytic-continuation claim; no identification of lattice correlators with q8 or q10; no laboratory, gravity, BV--BRST, QME or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: Use Omega=exp(lambda*phi)>0 and S_E=(2*lambda^2)^-1 sum_x[(Delta_L Omega)_x/Omega_x]^2 on a periodic connected graph, with sum_x phi_x=0. Keep the exact algebra and numerical observations as distinct evidence types. Run all numerical processes sequentially below the 500 MB virtual-memory cap.
